company.line: We build software that gives people back things modern life wore away: shared stories, hands-on curiosity, home cooking, and the confidence to look after their own affairs.

projects.name: Kathaa 360
projects.problem: Daily spoken storytelling used to give families something to share and talk about. Many children and older people now spend evenings alone, with nothing to say to each other.
projects.audience: Children home alone, busy adults who want one good hour instead of endless scrolling, and isolated older people.
projects.today: A web app with the series The 12 Jyotirlingas (first 3 chapters): Sanskrit verses with transliteration, a story read aloud, a private journal, and a deliberate 60-minute daily limit.
projects.future: More series (myths, history, children's bedtime knowledge), family accounts, and narration in familiar voices with recorded consent.

projects.name: Dish (What Do I Cook Today?)
projects.problem: More meals are being ordered in, and more people live alone, so everyday cooking is becoming a lost skill and cooking for one feels pointless.
projects.audience: People living alone, beginners, and anyone who cannot decide what to make from what is in the kitchen.
projects.today: An early public version: type the ingredients you have and it suggests a dish with beginner-friendly, numbered steps. 16 built-in everyday dishes, with no-oil variants and flavour tips.
projects.future: Making home cooking for one practical again: wider recipes, pantry-aware suggestions, and meals that fit a solo routine.

projects.name: Circuit Lab 360
projects.problem: Electronics feels closed to people who know nothing about it: the tools assume you already understand the maths.
projects.audience: Complete beginners, students, and curious tinkerers.
projects.today: In design. The specification is written: a circuit sandbox where you place and wire parts and a tutor explains in plain language what is happening and warns before a part fails. No public build yet.
projects.future: A guided path from first circuit to board-level thinking, built on a real circuit simulator.

projects.name: Hrushimanju
projects.problem: Most people own clothes that do not suit their colouring and have no affordable way to find out what does.
projects.audience: Anyone who wants to dress well from the wardrobe they already own.
projects.today: In development: AI-guided personal colour analysis applied to the clothes you already own. Research and legal groundwork are underway; no public site yet.
projects.future: Knowing what to wear without hiring a colourist.

projects.name: ConsumerSuit
projects.problem: Tenants, consumers and employees with a genuine claim often cannot afford help and do not know where to start.
projects.today: A live web app that helps you set out your UK rights case clearly and in order, with the relevant law explained along the way.
projects.future: More case types and clearer guidance at every step.

projects.name: Astral Nexus
projects.problem: Astrology tools are scattered, ad-ridden, and rarely explain their method.
projects.audience: People curious about their Moon sign, rising sign and nakshatra.
projects.today: A live site with reading tools across traditions.
